scripts.name: LavaRiseScript
scripts.scriptString: const lava = context.findInstance('LavaFloor'); if (lava) { const cycleSeconds = 8; const amplitude = 3; const baseY = -0.5; const phase = (Date.now()/1000 % cycleSeconds)/cycleSeconds; const wave = (Math.sin(phase*Math.PI*2 - Math.PI/2)+1)/2; lava.y = baseY + wave*amplitude; lava.mesh.position.y = lava.y; lava.updateHitbox(); }
